subject: Data residency playbook & network constraints — follow-up
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@medcenterhealth.org>, Cindy Ross <cindy.ross@medcenterhealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Data residency playbook & network constraints — follow-up

Hi Sanjay / Cindy,

Great to meet today — thanks for walking through the environment and the regulatory drivers. Quick recap from our discovery call and the items I captured as blockers/requirements for a Redwood Private deployment at MedCenter: 

- Primary driver: HIPAA + state-level retention (records retained 6–7 years) and internal audit requirements.
- Deployment model: On-prem / VPC-hosted private runtime preferred (no public hosted model for PHI processing).
- Network constraint: The NJ site is effectively air-gapped for outbound internet; egress only allowed via two jump hosts through your firewall team.
- KMS/HSM: Must integrate with customer-managed keys; preference for on-prem HSM (PKCS#11) but we should also support AWS KMS for cloud-adjacent workloads.
- Audit & logs: Immutable request logs, per-tenant audit trail, and monthly export for compliance.
- Timeline: Procurement window target = Q1 2027; PoV in Q4 2026 if we can lock network requirements.

Attachments: I attached our network checklist and a short PoV outline to speed the technical review.

Next tangible steps I propose:
1) You, Sanjay, share a redacted network diagram and firewall rules (FW allowlist for jump hosts) — target: EOD Wed 11/4.
2) Redwood to schedule a 60-min deep-dive with your infra/security folks (Vivek and Marissa from my team) next week to validate HSM integration path and egress controls.
3) We’ll provide a draft mutual action plan and estimated sizing for a dedicated pool once we validate kernel/hardware constraints.

If that aligns, I’ll send a calendar invite for the deep-dive and include a short technical pre-read.

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Data residency playbook & network constraints — follow-up

Alex — thanks for the recap. Couple clarifications and added constraints from our side: 

- Network topology: Primary data center is in Parsippany, NJ. No direct outbound internet from the internal subnet that will host inference; all outbound traffic must traverse one of two hardened jump boxes owned by our network ops team. Those jump boxes allow outbound TLS to specific IPs only (we will supply the allowlist).
- Jump boxes perform TLS interception for outbound scanning; we cannot ship private keys offsite.
- HSM: We have an on-prem Thales nShield that supports PKCS#11. For cloud-attached workloads we use AWS KMS but the initial scope requires on-prem HSM integration.
- Data residency: PHI must remain within our environment; backups need to be encrypted and stored on our SAN — no third-party object storage unless contracted.
- Audit: We require signed log exports monthly and retention for 7 years.

We can share a redacted network diagram by EOD Wed 11/4. Also confirm whether Redwood Private can be installed in an air-gapped mode (installer and image transfer via SFTP or removable media) — we need installation paths that do not require outbound access.

If you can confirm the installation options and an initial list of firewall rules/AWS endpoints (if any) needed for the PoV, we’ll prioritize internal approvals.

— Sanjay
Director, Infrastructure Operations
MedCenter Health

Thanks Sanjay — very helpful details. Short answers up front and then proposed scheduling: 

Air-gapped installation options
- Yes — Redwood Private supports an air-gapped install path. We can provide signed images and an offline installer bundle (MD5/SHA256 checksums + PGP signature) that your team can transfer via SFTP or removable media.

HSM integration
- We’ve integrated with Thales nShield via PKCS#11 for other customers; we’ll map out the exact calls and keys required.

Network/egress
- For the PoV we typically need outbound access only for license activation and package verification; in air-gapped mode we can do manual activation and signed package manifests. For regular operations we will provide a minimal allowlist for telemetry/updates but that can be disabled per contract.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Deep-dive technical call — 60 minutes with your network/security + our infra leads (Marissa, Vivek). Proposed slots: Wed 11/4 10:00am ET or Thu 11/5 2:00pm ET. Please confirm.
2) You share the redacted network diagram and jump box egress rules by EOD Wed 11/4.
3) We’ll prepare an install playbook (air-gap and connected variants) and a draft Statement of Work / mutual action plan for procurement review.

I attached an initial PoV outline and our network checklist (spreadsheet) to help your team fill in the firewall/port list quickly.

If you confirm Wed 10am ET for the deep-dive I’ll send invites and a technical pre-read to your infra team.

Best,

Alex Martinez

Marissa / Vivek — summary + asks after Sanjay’s reply: 

- Site constraints: Air-gapped primary DC (Parsippany, NJ), limited egress via two jump hosts, on-prem Thales nShield (PKCS#11).
- Compliance: HIPAA + state retention 7 years, no third-party object storage allowed for backups unless explicitly contracted.
- Immediate asks for PoV pack:
  * Install playbook (air-gap, offline activation steps, checksum verification, PGP-signed images) — owner: Marissa
  * HSM integration notes and sample PKCS#11 config (call paths, cert mapping) — owner: Vivek
  * Minimal network allowlist for a connected PoV variant and a suggested list of telemetry endpoints that can be disabled — owner: Alex / Marissa
  * Draft mutual action plan + timeline for procurement (PoV -> Pilot -> Prod) — owner: Alex

Can we turn the install playbook + HSM notes into a single zip for EOD Fri 11/6? Sanjay wants the redacted network diagram by Wed; he expects our deep-dive to validate HSM and egress flows.

I’ll schedule the 60-min technical call for Wed 11/4 10:00am ET tentatively and include Sanjay/Cindy. Please accept or tell me alternate availability.

Thanks — Alex
